# 1 Enoch Chapter 10 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Ge'ez MS; cf. 4QEn (Aramaic) | **Section:** Book of the Watchers

---

**1** Then the Most High — the Holy and Great One — spoke. He sent Uriel to Lamech's son with this message:

**2** 'Go to Noah and tell him in my name: Hide yourself! Tell him what is coming — the whole earth will be destroyed. A flood is about to sweep over everything and wipe out all life.

**3** Teach him how to escape, so that his descendants may survive for all generations to come.'

**4** Then the Lord told Raphael: 'Bind Azazel hand and foot and throw him into the darkness. Dig a pit in the desert of Dudael and throw him in.

**5** Pile jagged rocks on top of him and seal him in darkness. Let him stay there forever, his face covered, never to see light again.

**6** On the great day of judgment, he will be hurled into the fire.

**7** Heal the earth that the angels wrecked. Announce its healing, so that the plague is stopped and not everyone dies because of the forbidden knowledge the Watchers passed on to their children.

**8** The whole earth has been ruined by what Azazel taught. Pin every sin on him.'

**9** Then God told Gabriel: 'Go after the illegitimate offspring — the children born from the union of angels and women. Destroy the Watchers' children. Turn them against each other so they wipe each other out in battle. They will not live long lives.

**10** Their fathers will beg on their behalf, but no request will be granted. They had hoped to live forever — they thought each one would last five hundred years.'

**11** Then the Lord told Michael: 'Go — bind Shemihazah and all his companions who defiled themselves by sleeping with human women.

**12** After their sons have killed each other and they have watched their beloved children destroyed, chain them for seventy generations in the earth's depths, until the day of their final judgment — the judgment that lasts forever.

**13** Then they will be dragged to the fiery abyss — the prison of eternal torment.

**14** Anyone else who is condemned will be chained with them until the end of all generations.

**15** Wipe out every spirit born from the Watchers, because they have devastated humanity.

**16** Destroy every evil thing on the face of the earth. Let wickedness end. Let righteousness and truth take root — and they will prove to be a blessing, planted in joy forever.

**17** Then the righteous will survive and live to see thousands of descendants. They will live out their youth and old age in complete peace.

**18** The whole earth will be farmed in righteousness, covered with trees, bursting with abundance.

**19** Beautiful trees will fill it, and vineyards will overflow with wine. Every seed planted will return a thousandfold, and every olive grove will produce ten times its oil.

**20** Purge the earth of every oppression, injustice, sin, and godless act. Wipe away every stain of corruption.

**21** Then all of humanity will turn to righteousness. Every nation will worship me and give me praise.

**22** The earth will be purified from every defilement, sin, and punishment. And I will never send such things upon it again — not for all generations, not forever.'


---

*PNEUMA notes: Dynamic equivalence rendering aimed at modern English readability. Ge'ez idioms are rendered by their functional English equivalents. Theological terms are translated for impact rather than etymological precision.*
